name: Colunga (Spain)
description: Quartered green, white, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Colunga (a fleur-de-lis, a bird and swans).
history: Municipal flag of Colunga; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Colunga arms — fleur-de-lis, bird and swans
